name: calculator
title: Calculator (exact arithmetic, units, dates)
description: Exact arithmetic, unit conversion and date arithmetic for agents on small local models, which get all three wrong (our own server): calculate evaluates an expression exactly with fractions while it can (0.1 + 0.2 = 0.3; sqrt, log, sin, factorial, comb, gcd, ... in floating point when needed), convert_units converts length, area, volume, mass, time, speed, temperature, data, energy, power, pressure and angles, date_diff and date_add count days, months and years with weekdays. Never eval: a small interpreter of Python's syntax tree, every intermediate result size-checked (no 9**9**9), a time limit per call. No network.
notes: Four tools with small schemas, made for local models: tell the model to use calculate for every calculation. 'exact' in an answer says whether the result is exact (fractions) or rounded (floating point). Years in convert_units are Julian years (365.25 days); date_diff's business days skip weekends only, no holidays.

tor.note: No network: it reaches nothing, so nothing of it goes through Tor (sandbox-ai gives a server without network no VPN).
